blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence: - A plugin system for export formats, so that PDF, XLSX, XML and JSON exports can be added later by dropping a module in `src/export/plugins/`.
findings.recommendation: The Why is only "Accountants copy invoices one by one into their spreadsheet at the end of each month." — a single CSV export answers it. Drop the plugin system from What Changes, drop "Decision: Exports go through a plugin registry" from design.md (its only alternative, "a single CSV function", is rejected as "not extensible", an extensibility no requirement asks for), and drop task 1.2 "Plugin registry discovering `src/export/plugins/`", which no requirement of spec.md backs. Keep `src/export/` to the CSV renderer and the route; a registry can come in its own change when a second format is actually requested.
findings.title: Plugin system for export formats nobody asked for

findings.evidence: The settings page SHALL let a user choose their preferred export format among the installed plugins.
findings.location: specs/invoice-export/spec.md#Requirement: Users choose their export format
findings.recommendation: Nothing in the Why asks for a per-user format preference, and with CSV as the only format there is nothing to choose. The requirement also cannot be verified as written: its scenario "WHEN a user picks CSV THEN exports use CSV" holds whatever the preference is, since the only route is `GET /invoices.csv`. Remove this requirement and its scenarios, the "A settings page where each user picks their preferred export format." line of proposal.md, the settings sentence of design.md, task 2.1, and `web/src/settings/` from Impact.
findings.title: Settings page for a preferred export format nobody asked for

findings.recommendation: The new `GET /invoices.csv?month=YYYY-MM` route exposes a month's invoices with customer names and totals, yet `security` and `personal-data` are unticked with no reason, so no expert reviews who may call it — and the spec has no scenario for an unauthenticated or unauthorized caller. The settings page adds UI under `web/src/settings/` with `user-interface` unticked. Tick `security` and `personal-data` (or give a reason on each line), and tick `user-interface` unless the settings page is removed per R-skeptic-2.
findings.title: Domains the plan touches are all unticked with no reason
